review_candidates.title: Assistant Manager, Infrastructure Architecture & Delivery
review_candidates.description: About FWD Group FWD Group (1828.HK) is a pan-Asian life and health insurance business that serves approximately 40 million customers across 10 markets, including BRI Life in Indonesia. FWD’s customer-led and tech-enabled approach aims to deliver innovative propositions, easy-to-understand products and a simpler insurance experience. Established in 2013, the company operates in some of the fastest-growing insurance markets in the world with a vision of changing the way people feel about insurance. FWD Group is listed on the main board of the Hong Kong Stock Exchange under the stock code 1828. For more information, please visit www.fwd.com For more information about FWD Hong Kong, please visit www.fwd.com.hk/ Summary This role is responsible for delivering, operating, and improving enterprise infrastructure and cloud platforms. It covers Azure monitoring and observability, cloud connectivity, hybrid identity, platform support, and automation. The role works with Enterprise Architecture, IT Security & Assurance, Application, IT Operations, managed-service providers, and vendors to deliver secure, reliable, scalable, and supportable services. The Job Manage assigned infrastructure work from requirement analysis and design through implementation, testing, production handover, and review. Deliver Azure infrastructure, connectivity, monitoring, identity, and platform requirements for business and application projects. Operate and improve Azure Managed Grafana, Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Application Insights, dashboards, alerts, reports, and monitoring integrations. Manage Azure connectivity components, including VNets, subnets, route tables, Private Endpoints, Private DNS Zones, and firewall dependencies. Support Azure PaaS services, Microsoft Power Platform, Microsoft Fabric, hybrid identity, and certificate lifecycle management. Provide L2/L3 support, investigate incidents, perform root-cause analysis, and coordinate resolution with internal teams, Microsoft, service providers, and vendors. Prepare implementation plans, change requests, risk assessments, test procedures, rollback plans, SOPs, runbooks, diagrams, and handover documents. Use Infrastructure as Code, scripting, Git-based configuration management, reusable templates, and automation to improve consistency, control, and efficiency. Manage vendor deliverables, technical proposals, quotations, service quality, risks, dependencies, and progress reporting. Support service governance, security reviews, production-readiness checks, operational acceptance, and continuous improvement. The Person At least five years of hands-on experience in infrastructure or cloud engineering, preferably in a regulated enterprise environment. Strong knowledge of Microsoft Azure infrastructure, networking, identity, role-based access control, and PaaS services. Practical experience with Azure Managed Grafana, Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Application Insights, KQL, dashboards, alerts, and diagnostic settings. Experience with Active Directory, ADFS, Web Application Proxy, SAML, OAuth, application registrations, service principals, and certificate-based authentication. Experience with automation and Infrastructure as Code using tools such as Terraform, ARM templates, Azure CLI, PowerShell, Python, and Git. Strong troubleshooting, analytical, documentation, communication, and vendor-management skills. Working knowledge of Microsoft Power Platform and Microsoft Fabric infrastructure dependencies is an advantage. We offer 5-day work, 20-22 days annual leaves, excellent learning & development opportunities and an attractive package to the right candidate. Information collected will be treated in strict confidence and used solely for recruitment purpose. The company will retain all applications no longer than 24 months of which will be destroyed thereafter. When there are vacancies in any of our subsidiaries, holding companies, associated or affiliated companies of, or companies controlled by, or under common control with the Company during that period, we may transfer your application to them for consideration of employment. We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, gender, disability or family status in employment process.

review_candidates.description: Parker Russell AJS Lahore is seeking an experienced IT Support professional for its UAE based project located in Lahore, Pakistan to provide day-to-day technical assistance, maintain IT systems, and ensure reliable network connectivity. The ideal candidate will have strong troubleshooting skills, a proactive approach, and the ability to communicate effectively with users and colleagues. Key Responsibilities Provide technical support for Windows and macOS computers, printers, scanners, mobile devices, and other IT equipment. Respond to help desk tickets, troubleshoot hardware, software, and network issues, and document resolutions. Set up desktops, laptops, and workstations for new employees, including Active Directory accounts, user profiles, email accounts, and signatures. Install, configure, and update operating systems and business applications. Maintain wired and wireless networks and troubleshoot LAN/WAN, DHCP, DNS, VPN, and Wi-Fi connectivity. Assist with the configuration and maintenance of routers, switches, firewalls, and access points. Monitor network performance and availability, and support endpoint protection and access controls. Manage file-server permissions, perform regular server backups, and maintain accurate IT asset records. Prepare technical reports and maintain documentation of incidents, troubleshooting, and system maintenance. Resolve IT issues proactively to minimise downtime and support business continuity. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor’s degree in Computer Applications or a related IT discipline. At least three years of relevant IT support experience. Strong practical knowledge of hardware, software, operating systems, and network troubleshooting. Familiarity with CCNA, MCSA, and ITIL frameworks or relevant certifications would be an advantage. Strong problem-solving, documentation, communication, and teamwork skills. How to Apply Please apply here or email your CV to ali@parkerrussellajs.com with the subject line “Application – IT Support – Lahore.” This position requires working on-site at our office in Lahore, Pakistan.
